speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our consultation regarding your hand tremors and recent memory issues, could you please describe when you first noticed these symptoms and if the tremor worsens when your hands are at rest or when you are using them?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive impairment (Dementia with Lewy Bodies).
